text: Tis an amazin' wine we bottled this year.
zh: 今年我们装瓶的这酒可真是绝了。

text: After two bottles I ssssurely can conf...
zh: 两瓶下肚，我绝绝绝对可以证……

text: As a winemaker you sometimesss have to lend a hand.
zh: 身为酿酒师，有时候就就就得亲自搭把手。

text: What do you know about the wine problem?
zh: 关于葡萄酒的问题，你知道些什么？

text:
I heard sssomething. Sure!
Tis 'n easy problem to me.
zh:
我倒是听说了点事事事。当然！
这问题对我来说简单得很。

text:
The academy wine has a very ssspecific taste.
It's our tradition.
zh:
学院的葡萄酒有种非常独独独特的味道。
这是我们的传统。

text: In the librarary is a book explainin' what makes our wine the best.
zh: 图书书馆里有本书，讲的就是我们的酒为啥是最好的。

text: I don't have access to the library.

zh:
图……图书……馆。
图书书馆！

text: Basicallily, you need to know that we only use the best grapes for our wine.
zh: 基本本上呢，你要知道，我们酿酒只用最好的葡萄。

text: Don't let anyone fool you by sain' we use anything else.
zh: 别让人骗你说我们还加了别的东西。

text:
Honey or herbs?
Nah! Not in our academy wine!
zh:
蜂蜜还是香草？
不不！我们学院的酒里可没这些！
